meta_description:
3,604 likes, 334 comments - shenaztreasury on September 7, 2026: "Being a travel influencer has spoiled me! 
Free flights. Free hotels. Hosted trips.

But then I travel on my own and suddenly I’m like, wait, I have to PAY for things? 😂

So I got myself Scapia Axis Bank Credit card.

No forex markup when I’m abroad and works seamlessly in 180+ countries. 
I earn rewards when I book travel on the app.
Those rewards go towards free flights and hotels.

And the card itself is free.

Basically, I like free travel ;) 🧳".
